AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire
devices using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings
are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City
Clerk's Office. For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public
comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed. If you have
any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the Library,
Arts and Culture Department, at (818) 548-2030, during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E.
Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  OCTOBER 20, 2022 AT 2:00 PM

REVISED
  - Item 5c: Staff Report and Motion was added.

minutes_text:
CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, October 20, 2022 at 2:00 p.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on October 20, 2022 at 2:04 p.m.
  •  Present: Commissioner Zadorian, Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  •  The Agenda for the October 20, 2022 Regular Meeting was posted on October 17, 2022 on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (INCLUDING MINUTES)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the Commission or the
  audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before motion is proposed.

  a. Minutes of the August 18, 2022 Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.
  Moved:  Commissioner Vidor
  Seconded: Commissioner Viar

  Ayes:  Commissioners Zadorian, Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

  b. Minutes of the August 31, 2022 Special Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.

  Moved:  Commissioner Viar
  Seconded: Commissioner Vidor

  Ayes:  Commissioners Zadorian, Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

3. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  a. New Staff: Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator, Arts & Culture
  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones formally introduced Loreto Lopez as the new Program Coordinator for the Arts and
  Culture Commission; Ms. Loreto thanked the Commission and expressed her gratitude in working
  alongside the Commission.

  b. New Staff: Enyjé Mai-Ling Sandoz, Public Arts Intern
  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones introduced Enyjé Mai-Ling Sandoz as the temporary Public Arts Intern from a
  grant funded by L.A. County Department of Arts & Culture.

  c. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Principal Arts & Culture
  Administrator
  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

  1
 4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes. Members of
  the Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the Speaker, but there will be no Debate or
  Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  – None

6. DISCUSSION ITEM(s) / REPORT(s) Moved up with permission of Chairperson Yank
  a. City-Wide Public Art Landmarks RFQ: Round #2 - LeBasse Projects Update
  • Bo Basse of LeBasse Projects presented their proposed location recommendations for public art
  within the City to the Arts and Culture Commission.
  • Commission asked questions and gave their feedback.
  • Mr.Steven Meek, Community Services and Parks Commissioner, gave a brief update of the
  upcoming renovation of Fremont Park, a proposed public art location.

5. ACTION ITEM(s)
  a. Public Hearing: Design Review of the Mural, “Bright Minds Childcare Center,” Located at 2512
  Weston Place.
  • Chairperson opened the hearing to the public and public comment.
  • Ms Fukutomi –Jones gave a brief description of the Design review report.

  1. Motion approving, with conditions, design review of the Mural “Bright Minds Childcare Center,” located
  at 2512 Weston Place.
  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded: Commissioner Viar

  That (1) after having reviewed and considered the Principal Arts & Culture Administrator’s October 20,
  2022 Report (including its attachments and exhibits) regarding design review, under Section
  30.33.230 of the Glendale Municipal Code (GMC), 1995, of the mural, “Bright Minds Childcare
  Center,” by Lilit A. (Axiom Print), located at 2512 Weston Place, (2) after having conducted a
  public hearing in accordance with GMC Section 30.61.010, and (3) after having received testimony at
  the hearing, the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves the mural.

  Ayes:  Commissioners Zadorian, Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

  b. Nomination of one Commissioner to the Artist Review & Selection Committee for the Poet
  Laureate Program RFP.
  1. Motion appointing one Commissioner to the Artist Review & Selection Committee for the Poet
  Laureate Program RFP.
  •  Nicole Pasini, Assistant Director of Glendale Library Arts & Culture gave a brief report on the Poet
  Laureate Program.
  •  Commission asked questions and gave their feedback.
  •  Commissioner Zadorian nominated herself; Commissioner Vidor supported nomination.
  Moved:  Commissioner Tufenkian
  Seconded: Commissioner Viar

  2
   That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby appoints Commissioner Zadorian to the Artist Review
  & Selection Committee for the Poet Laureate Pilot Program RFP, as more fully outlined in the
  October 20, 2022 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  Ayes:  Commissioners Zadorian, Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

  c. Arts and Culture Commission Regular Meeting
  1. Motion recommending that City Council approve the Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture
  Commission to be re-scheduled to an alternate date and time.
  •  Commission asked questions and gave their feedback.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded: Commissioner Tufenkian

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby recommends that City Council approve the
  rescheduling of the Commission’s monthly Regular Meeting from the 3rd Thursday of the month,
  2:00PM - 4:00PM, to the 2nd Thursday of the month, 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM, as more fully outlined in
  the October 20, 2022 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administration.

  Ayes:  Commissioners Zadorian, Tufenkian, Vidor, Vice Chair Viar, Chairperson Yank
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  None

6. DISCUSSION ITEM(s) / REPORT(s)
  a. City-Wide Public Art Landmarks RFQ: Round #2 - LeBasse Projects Update – item
  6A Moved up agenda per Chairperson Yank

  b. 2022-2023 Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. Art Happens Anywhere – Projects Culmination
  Staff is working on a Projects Culmination/Celebration Reception to take place
  tentatively on Saturday, December 3, 2022, 12:00PM – 2:00PM at the Museum of Neon
  Art.

  ii. Mural Ordinance – Update
  Staff is working with Ms. Odenkirk on the draft Mural Ordinance and Policies and
  Procedures and, will be scheduled for initial review by the Commission at an upcoming
  Regular Meeting.

  iii. Creative Crosswalks – Update
  The Creative Crosswalks RFP application closed on September 23, 2022 at 5:00 PM,
  and Staff received over 54 applications for consideration. Staff shared the finalists of the
  Creative Crosswalks RFP opportunity. Presented a PowerPoint of proposed streets and
  mural proposals.
  • Commission asked questions and gave their feedback.
  • Steven Meek, Community Services and Parks Commissioner gave his feedback.

  3
   2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS
  i.  Beyond the Box – Update
  On August 31, 2022, the Artist Review & Selection Committee for the Beyond the Box
  program met to review applications. Staff shared the five finalists for this year’s Beyond the
  Box program. The utility box murals will be painted from October 21-23, 2022.
  • Commission asked questions and gave their feedback.

  3. PERFORMING ARTS
  i. 222 East Concert Series – Update

  On October 1, 2022, the 222 East Concert Series kicked off with a performance by Salsa
  Caliente. The last concert will take place on Saturday, October 29, 2022, featuring the
  Big Butter Jazz Band.

  4. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update

  5. MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS
  i. PR Firm RFP – Update

  Public Relations Firm – Request for Proposals (RFP)
  On Friday, September 30, 2022, the Public Relations Firm – Request for Proposals
  application closed, and Staff received 6 proposals for consideration. Staff is currently in
  the process of reviewing the proposals, and will be able to provide an update soon.

  c. Art Alleyways
  • Mr. Steven Meek, Community Services and Parks Commissioner, suggested potential art in
  alleyways within the City and thanked the Commission for their consideration.
  • Commission asked questions and gave their feedback.

7. COMMISSION / STAFF COMMENTS
  •  Commissioner Tufenkian shared that during an opening art reception and stated that there were
  Curators, Directors and Boards of Trustees from various museums around Los Angeles and a pretty
  notable person stated that “Glendale is getting the reputation of an art hub.”; Commissioner Vidor
  stated that she agrees and that people are taking notice about Glendale.
  •  Commissioner Vidor had a couple of acknowledgments and gave a shout out to Glendale Arts and
  stated she attended two events at the Glendale International Film Festival. Commissioner Vidor also
  thanked Shannon Currie Holmes and Deb Thompson, Associates President of Brand Associates for
  putting together an amazing show for the 50th anniversary of Brand Works On Paper and also
  congratulated Corey Seagull, Director of MONA and the Museum of Art for receiving an award at the
  Annual Los Angeles Conservancy & Preservation Awards for their expansive celebration of Los
  Angeles’ Neon heritage and for their amazing amount of public engagement.
  •  Chairperson Yank stated she’s very thankful to be part of this Commission and is excited to have
  Loreto on board with more hours, she advocated for more staff for Arts and Culture. Chairperson also
  stated that the City needs an eco-system of artists, non-profits and she’s seeing a space crisis for
  artists and nonprofits in the county of Los Angeles and asked for everyone to have their eyes open for
  and ask what tools the City has to be able to provide affordable space and opportunities for artists and
  art organizations.
  •  Mike Grant announced his retirement and thanked the Commission for the opportunity to assist the
  Commission and have done an incredible job. Commission and Staff congratulated and wished him the
  best of luck.
  •  Commission thanked staff for all their great work; Dr. Shaffer thanked the Commission for their
  participation in helping to transform Glendale into an Arts and Culture destination.
  4
 8. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS - None
9. ADJOURNMENT 3:53 pm
The next Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission is January 12, 2023, at 10:00 a.m., in City
Council Chambers (2nd Floor), 613 E. Broadway.
